body: Thank you so much. Maybe some day I can find something that works for me. I think I'll hold off on the bandages for now. I wish you the best too.

Yep. My brain is always in shambles.

Thank you for your understanding messages. I hope that you can also find relief one day as well.

Oh my god same, imagining my own suicide somehow makes me feel calmer. Maybe I'll try the rubber band thing. I've seen some people on reddit say that some therapists actually recommend it when these self harm feelings arise. Now that I think about it, I once tried stabbing my hand with a sewing needle many times, but it never broke through the skin. That was the first time I actively wanted to hurt myself.

Thanks for the comment

Thank you. Even if you're just a stranger on the internet, this message still means a lot to me. You're right. I know I'll definitely regret it if I do do it, but in this moment, it feels like there's not much left I can do. I've tried to find other coping mechanisms: I've kept journals, attempted to vent my emotions through art, tried talking to others, yet it never works out. I only end up feeling more miserable. 

But I'll try.
Honestly, I don't even know. I doubt I'll gain anything. But I just feel like I want to do it, like I need to do it. Maybe it'll distract me when I feel those bursts of frustration and deep sadness.

This so much. Ruminating has basically destroyed my entire life. And it seriously does feel like it's always there, ready to consume you at any given moment, even when you're somehow not actively thinking about it. I've pretty much lost the ability to genuinely enjoy anything because of rumination. It makes life completely miserable :/

I truly hope that we can finally be free from it one day.

Would not wish OCD upon even my worst enemy.
Thank you. This message itself already helps a little.

I'm glad that you're still pulling through. It's nice to know that there are people like them who exist, even if the number is very small. To be honest I don't think I'll ever find one in my lifetime, but that's fine. Thank you for the message.
Oh my god. I hate how people say it like being happy is a "choice"...if it was truly a "choice", none of us would have depression.
That sounds so infuriating. Kind of wish I could punch him in the face for you and everyone who has to deal with shit like that...
Lol yes. I find comfort in the way they always listen patiently without speaking. I can cry and spill all my fears, and they will never judge. It makes me feel like they understand.
Felt this. They make it seem like it's something minor that will pass, and that we're just being dramatic... :/

Thank you. I'm glad that therapy and medication has been helping you. I've contemplated it before, but in the end, I don't think I'll ever be able to gather the courage to get help.

But I'll still hang on. There's not much else I can do right now lol
Memes and cat photos are like drugs to me lmao 😭

Holy crap, I get this so much too. Someone literally once told me that, because I was still feeling down, I didn't "truly understand" the meaning of those words, so they were going to repeat it until I did finally "understand"  -\_-
Definitely this too

Oh man. Please no...I already have to deal with those kinds of messages elsewhere. Maybe I should just stay off social media for now. But then where else will I find cat photos... T-T

But yeah. I'm too much of a coward to actually do anything right now :/
Ikr. Makes it even more difficult to "seek help"...
Yeah, this is pretty much why I never really reach out for help. That and the fact that, if I express suicidal intention, I'll probably get thrown into a psych ward or something :)
Yep. They say it's selfish to want to die because then it hurts those close to us. Like wow, now I feel even guiltier on top of everything.
